native_generation: Same legal base and controlled O1 ending as the domain boundary. Native server tests encode and decode the actual monster.choose before execution and project the original before/after snapshots after authoritative restore.
Godot_checks: Original source, actor, room/revision, capacity, pending/active instance identity and order, hand identity/order, library/discard counts, available actions and actual Game intent guards.
return_path: Godot encodes each original choice. Native server codec decodes all 279 commands and joins by room/request to the original native command, checks full typed equivalence and rejects missing/duplicate originals. Generic CI fallback is excluded from this required profile.
raw_primary_storage: local G drive, verified direct streaming before cloud cleanup
